items.title: Full scan vs. B-tree: comparisons needed to find one row
items.description: Drag the row count and watch worst-case comparisons for a full scan (grows with every row) versus a B-tree lookup (grows with the logarithm of the row count). The default reproduces the opening scenario's exact 2,000,000-row case.
items.compute: const scanComparisons = params.rowCount; const btreeComparisons = Math.ceil(Math.log2(params.rowCount)); return { scanComparisons, btreeComparisons };
